title: Robert Hastings feels subliminally guided toward disclosure

tellings.quote: I was on the phone yesterday with Robert Hastings who wrote UFOs and nukes and he's telling me that he feels like he's being sublim subliminally guided

plain: Robert Hastings, who wrote the book UFOs and Nukes, says he feels he is being subliminally guided, nudged without knowing it, toward disclosure, the public revealing of what is known about UFOs. A guest named Mike Masters passes this on in 2023, saying he had been "on the phone yesterday" with Hastings. If true, it would suggest some unseen influence steering people who work on the subject.
